newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji drops, hurt by newspaper report.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji drops, hurt by newspaper report.

text.p: Shares of Takefuji Corp dropped on the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Friday morning, as recent worries over the consumer finance firm were heightened by a newspaper report about the purchase of Takefuji shares by a former financial ministry official before the shares were registered on the OTC market, traders said.
The share price was down 270 yen at 8,490 yen at 0104 GMT. Volume was 58,000 shares.
Takefuji officials were not immediately available to comment, but the company said before the market's opening on Friday that it did not think the purchase caused any legal problems.
